# Code Notes made by Vaibhav Rathod

> A comprehensive programming knowledge base covering languages, algorithms, data structures, data science, DevOps, Game Development, Free resources, software engineering, software lists and more.

## High-level Summary
Free Code Notes is a structured repository of programming knowledge, designed for developers of all levels. It covers core computer science concepts, modern web and game development, and infrastructure management.

## Key Sections
- Programming Languages: Python, Java, C++, Go, Rust, C , C# , JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Ruby, Ada, Crystal, SQL, HTML, CSS, GDScript, Bash, etc.
- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- System Design
- DevOps & CI/CD
- Game Development (Godot, Unity, Unreal)
- Cybersecurity & Linux Internals
- Data Science & Machine Learning
